ARTICLE.selection_and_interpretation: Current integrated scientific account: Methods 2.1–2.7, Results 3.1–3.6, Appendix A. Its E01–E05 evidence boundary governs findings.

E01_INTERVENTIONS.selection_and_interpretation: Source sign is baseline minus intervention. Reverse estimate and interval order if presenting intervention minus baseline. Multiply proportions by 100 for percentage points.

E01_PRIMARY.selection_and_interpretation: Use published rows. Signs are rejected minus accepted. History final-window interval includes zero.

archived_rows.definition: Post-initial authentic action rate, rejected minus accepted.
The same action-frequency information in normalized objective-loss units. Exact identity: regret contrast = -(T-1)/T x sampling contrast (freeze C.5). Not an independent confirmation.
Final-window mask rate contrast. Interval spans zero: a failure to detect, not an established equivalence.

E01_WEIGHTING.selection_and_interpretation: p=.65, maintained baseline, lambda=2.5 versus .5. Masking is objectively optimal in this cell.

E02_EFFECTS.selection_and_interpretation: For the main-talk intensity row select effect_name=graded_minus_binary_final_window_mean_disclosure, level=across_master_seeds, p=pooled_equal_weight_p_0.75_0.85, stratum=rejected.

E02_PRIMARY.selection_and_interpretation: Use pooled equal-weight p=.75/.85 and rejected stratum. The regret row is binary minus graded; reverse sign and limits to express graded minus binary.

archived_rows.definition: Graded nonzero-disclosure post-initial rate minus binary full-authentic post-initial rate.
Graded minus binary full-authentic final-window selection rate.
Graded minus binary probability that the unique final-window modal arm is the objective endpoint d = 1.
Binary minus graded normalized regret. In the affine cells per-step normalized regret is exactly 1 - d, so this is a horizon-average disclosure-distance contrast (freeze C.6).

E03_CELLS.selection_and_interpretation: Figure 8 provenance and its generator identify all fifteen setting rows and five disagreement sentinels. Do not include the .35/0 control in the 25-denominator matrix.

E03_GRID.selection_and_interpretation: Use publication_category and all 357 (p,eta) cells. Preserve inconclusive cells. Counts describe parameter space.

E03_THRESHOLDS.selection_and_interpretation: Numerical brackets and midpoint thresholds are objective solver precision, not Monte Carlo confidence intervals.

E04_CURVES.selection_and_interpretation: For context-count plots select fixed identity, one-good regime, requested/effective K=1,2,4,8,16 within architecture, and equal-weight masters. Resolve exact field names from the header and frozen Figure 9 provenance. Abundance endpoint panel selects K=16 and one versus four good contexts.

E04_EFFECTS.selection_and_interpretation: Select level=across_master_seeds and the exact metric/architecture/contrast in effect_name. Final mask frequency, encounter, regret and modal classification are distinct fields.

E04_HEADLINE.selection_and_interpretation: These are primarily modal and abundance-slope effects. Do not use them as confidence intervals on descriptive total-masking endpoints.

E05_CELLS.selection_and_interpretation: For actual masking/modal comparisons select bf=0,.30,.325,8/17 and flat_2k, averaging the five master rows equally. Use the distinct masking and modal fields.

E05_CROSSINGS.selection_and_interpretation: Use the flat_2k archived point and CI. Hierarchical is left-censored below .30 and has no numeric in-range crossing.

archived_rows.censoring_note: Left-censored below the observed dense range; no in-range crossing is estimable and none may be extrapolated.

E05_RESPONSE.selection_and_interpretation: Observed pooled response points. Do not refit or rerun the bootstrap. Resolve target response as modal_good_auth_argmax_fraction.

E06_CODE.selection_and_interpretation: _family resets p and Q at every segment for reversal_only and cold_start. Inspect actual state handling, not the path name alone.

E06_QUALIFICATION.selection_and_interpretation: Staged deferred design. approved_qualification is false.

E06_STANDARD.selection_and_interpretation: Staged design, not executed standard evidence. approved_standard is false; separate canonical GO is absent.
